description: Header file defining interface for the map adjustment algorithm used in an auto-tuning core component. It declares functions for initialization, running adjustments, adding AFR data points, and retrieving adjustment multipliers.

methods.name: runMapAdjustments
methods.description: Executes map adjustments with a provided callback function.

methods.name: addAfr
methods.description: Adds an AFR (Air-Fuel Ratio) point associated with a specific RPM and key.

methods.name: getMultiplier
methods.description: Retrieves the adjustment multiplier for a given RPM and key.
